The Jedi Grandmaster, [[Satele Shan]], owned a '''double-bladed''' '''lightsaber''' during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==History==
[[File:Sundjem_Doublelightsaber.png|250px|thumb|Satele's lightsaber is destroyed by Darth Malgus]]
Satele Shan wielded her second [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] during the [[battle of Alderaan]], injuring several Sith warriors along with damaging a Mark I Sith droid before entering a duel with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. During the duel, it was [[Sun djem/Legends|cut in half]] by Malgus as he tried to kill Shan.<ref name="Hope" />
